programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight

programme.title: Hercules in New York

programme.title: What If

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis

programme.title: The Golden Child

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Tully

programme.title: Scary Movie 2

programme.title: Daredevil

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Two
programme.desc: A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Obsolete Man

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Gift

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Brock and the O.S.I. come under fire from the higher ups when they lose two high value super-criminal prisoners. Somebody helped them escape, and everyone aboard the hover-quarters is a suspect in this 22 minute potboiler - even the visiting Ventures.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: A friendship built on lies threatens to unravel Dr. Venture's sanity. But Hank and Henchman 21 are the ones getting committed to an asylum. And Dean's growing relationship with a mystery woman is only making everyone crazier.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Brock and the O.S.I. launch a bold and bizarre surveillance mission against one of the Council of 13's top members. But the mission takes a turn for the worse when Doc and Billy get caught up in the super-villain crossfire.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture is missing... presumed dead. Sgt. Hatred sends Hank and Dean to live with their godfathers to keep them out of harm's way while he forges an unlikely alliance with Henchman 21 to wreak vengeance.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Join the Ventures--and pretty much everyone they've ever crossed paths with--as they rocket to the Gargantua-2 space station for an epic, hour-long adventure that will change the Ventureverse as we know it forever.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Ventures are back! And they’re movin’ on up to a deluxe apartment in the sky. But will mo’ money bring mo’ problems? And can The Monarch handle the commute?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: As White & Billy grapple with their arch enemy back in the old ‘hood, Doc realizes he can’t face his new responsibilities alone when a whale of an enemy shows him how they arch uptown.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: A brutish supervillain launches an assault on the Ventures. Will Doc’s latest invention, or a mysterious blue vigilante, save the day? Probably not.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: In a case of mistaken identity, the Guild targets Dr. Venture for assassination, pooping his party for a fancy new friend.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.sub-title: The Venture Bros. & the Curse of the Haunted Problem

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.desc: Deadly waters surround the Monarch when he becomes Wide Wale's prisoner in Part 2 of the Morphic Trilogy.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.desc: The Morphic Trilogy reaches its stunning conclusion in a decades-spanning tale of friendship, betrayal, and mass murder that overwrites Venture history.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Terrible Secret of Turtle Bay, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When the Venture Family visits Tijuana for a lecture Dr. Venture is giving at the (community) University of Mexico, the dastardly Monarch weaves a cocoon of villainy that leaves the Venture brothers trapped in his clutches, Dr. Venture kidney-less and Brock... dead? If only Dr. Venture would return the Monarch's calls...

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture, Pete White and Master Billy Quizboy are invited to take part in a top secret government think tank.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Are You There God, It's Me, Dean

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Always short on cash, Dr. Venture decides to unload some of his father's old scientific equipment in a huge yard sale that attracts fellow scientists and super-villains alike. Everyone is supposed to be on their best behavior, but The Monarch can't resist the temptation to wreak havoc once he finds himself inside the "belly of the beast"... nor can he find a bathroom.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock and Dr. Venture are kidnapped from the funeral of a college friend, the boys enlist the aid of the original Team Venture: a group of superscience adventurers who worked for their grandfather in the sixties.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Monarch is on trial for the one crime he may not have committed, under mysterious circumstances stemming from his bitter breakup with Dr. Girlfriend. The boys and Dr. Orpheus are forced to testify, but only Brock is aware that something far more sinister is afoot.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture finally learns the secret of his recurring womb nightmares when a stomach tumor turns out to be something far more sinister.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Powerless in the Face of Death

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Aided by Henchmen 21, 24 and a ragtag band of roughneck new recruits, The Monarch attempts to rebuild his villainous empire and rekindle his relationship with Dr. Girlfriend. programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.desc: Team Venture find themselves trapped in the clutches of a bloodthirsty Egyptian cult.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

Doc and Brock become the unwitting pawns in a low-grade pissing contest when Phantom Limb's sics the Guild's commandos on the Venture compound to prove his dominance. Can Brock hold off an army? Can Doc escape death and finish watching the worst porno ever?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall
programme.desc: Owen Jones makes his PolJOE debut to discuss Western decline and his book The Fall of the West. He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: The Dark Money Behind Keir Starmer's Rise
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Peter Geoghegan discusses Labour Together, the organisation that shaped Keir Starmer's leadership project. Geoghegan explains how the group functioned less like a traditional thinktank and more like a political campaign machine backed by significant undeclared funding. That money, he argues, was used to build the polling, messaging, and strategy that underpinned Starmer's rise.

programme.title: The Grand Tour's Francis, Thomas & James Take On The British Test

programme.title: Stranger Things Cast Lift Lid On Final Ending & Much More

From hilarious cast banter to emotional reflections on the show's journey, this interview dives deep into the Upside Down one last time.

programme.title: Ultimate Quiz

programme.desc: Sienna Miller, Dominic West and Nick Mohammed go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. From The Wire, Ted Lasso and Layer Cake to Burnt, WAR, G.I. Joe and The Affair, do they know their famous lines, recognise the iconic images and remember the details from their own careers?

programme.title: Pierce Brosnan Eats Tayto And Talks Hurling

programme.title: Charlie's Angels S5E104
programme.desc: Motion picture executive Jonathan Tobias hires Bosley and the Angels to track down someone dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men who has been shooting arrows into studio personnel. Tobias knows that the arrows are aimed at him when his chauffeur is hit. Charlie arranges for the Angels to enroll in stunt school and then go to work as stuntwomen on a picture called "Marian and her Merry Maids" -- a bad remake of an old Errol Flynn classic. The Angels become friendly with one of the maids, Ellen Travers, and her husband, Jeff. Ellen, a former rodeo queen, has become enamored with movies. Jeff is trying desperately to get her to quit the movies and go back home with him. Bosley learns that one of the security guards, Jake Webner, was in the original picture with his idol -- Errol Flynn. Ellen Travers is hit with an arrow while driving a wagon during one of the scenes. It is Jake who has been dressing as Robin Hood's man with the bow and arrow, trying to get to Tobias because he feels that Tobias has been making bad movies. Jake is eventually caught while shooting an arrow into the director's foot. However, Bosley discovers that Jake was on guard duty when Ellen Travers was shot. Her husband, Jeff, who was trying to scare her into giving up movies, really shot her. Jake and Jeff are both taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels S5E105
programme.desc: Edward Tustin, head of a group trying to take over Western Techtronics, engages efficiency expert, Dr. John Reardon of Executive Assistants, to have the four members of Techtronics who oppose his takeover killed. Reardon has hypnotized three girls for the job Darlene Warren, Cynthia Weaver and Francine Miller. He uses motivational Pavlovian and Sensory conditioning and the subjects kill without fear, passion or memory. After the Chairman of the Board and a Vice President of Techtronics are killed and Francine Miller's body is found with them, the Angels are hired by company President, Steve Briggs. Briggs realizes he is next on the list. Kelly and Kris join Techtronics as executive trainees and Julie applies as Executive Assistant. She is hypnotized by Dr. Reardon, who uses flashing strobe effects, a candle and a water tank. After Julie has become completely programmed, she is sent to kill Briggs and almost succeeds when the suspicious Kelly and Kris arrive and save him. Julie is then deprogrammed by a doctor who explains that fire and water are two of the strongest hypnotic symbols. Reardon, Tustin and their associates are taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels S5E106
programme.desc: After twelve different banks have been robbed of a quarter of a million dollars in hundred dollar bills, the Angels are called in to investigate. All the banks have the same type of automatic teller. Ted Markham, a computer and electronics genius who designed and installed the automatic tellers, has quit his job. Kris volunteers to become acquainted with Markham with the intention of obtaining some of the bills so that the serial numbers may be traced. Kris follows Markham to a poker parlor where he takes out a stack of $100 bills and with the help of a wrist calculator is a big winner. Ted and Kris are attracted to each other and they take off for Las Vegas in Kris' car. While in Las Vegas, Kris manages to get some of the bills away from Ted. She phones the serial numbers to Bosley and soon learns that they are part of the missing money. After Ted has won $300,000, he is asked to leave Las Vegas by the casino owner. On the way out of town, Ted stops at a bank while Kris waits in the car. When they arrive back in California, at the spot where Ted left his car, Kelly, Julie and Bosley are waiting with the police to take Ted into custody. Bosley then finds that Ted is free to go due to the fact that when he deposited the money in the bank in Las Vegas, he had paid back each of the twelve banks with interest, and they will not prosecute. Even though Ted and Kris have strong feelings for each other, they realize their relationship would not be the same -- so they sadly part.
